title: Set up your products
why: Add every product you sell, with how many are on the shelf and a photo. When all are added, our field team calls you to fix the visit.
beforeApproval: Your visit is booked. Products added since need their count and photo before the field team can approve the shop.
addOneByOne: Or add products one by one
readingWait: We're reading your list. It takes about a minute.

waitChecking.one: {count} photo is being checked. Come back in a few minutes.
waitChecking.other: {count} photos are being checked. Come back in a few minutes.

askOwnerToFinish: Everything is added. Ask the owner to tap “I've added all my products”.
askOwnerMessage: All products of {shop} are added in the Clozest Partner app. Please open it and tap “I've added all my products”.
finishAskTitle: Have you added everything you sell?
finishAskBody: After this, our field team calls you to fix a time for the visit. You can still add products later.
finishUnsure: We couldn't tell if that went through ({message}). Tap again: it's safe.
fixPages: See the pages to take again
doneBody: Our field team calls you to fix a time for the visit. Products you add now go on the shelf at once.

pageLeftOut.one: {count} product on this page didn't fit. Photograph the end of the page again.
pageLeftOut.other: {count} products on this page didn't fit. Photograph the end of the page again.

deleteAskBody: Its lines still to check go with it. Products already added from it stay.
listIntro: Your own list of products (a notebook, a printout): one page per photo. We read the products from it, and you check each one.
retakeIntro: Take this page again, flat and in good light. The page that couldn't be read is removed once the new one is sent.
takePagePhoto: Take a photo of the page

pageSent.one: Page sent. We're reading it: about a minute. Meanwhile, photograph the next page.
pageSent.other: {count} pages sent. We're reading them. Photograph the next page, or go back to check the lines.

leaveSending: A photo is still being sent. Leave anyway? It will have to be taken again.
sendUnsure: We couldn't tell if it was sent ({message}). Try again: it won't be sent twice.
yourPriceHint: What you sell it for. Change it if it's not the MRP.
countLabel: How many are on the shelf now?
countKgLabel: How many kg are on the shelf now?
countHint: Count them now. 0 if there are none.
countHintYours: Count them now: this becomes its stock. 0 if there are none.
countNeeded: Count them now. 0 if there are none.
decideUnsure: We couldn't tell if it was saved ({message}). Tap again: it won't be added twice.
addAndNext: Add and go to the next
skipHint: Skip headings, totals, or things you don't sell any more.
lineGone: That line isn't there any more (its page was deleted). Here's the next one.
alreadyCountedBody: {name} was counted from another line: {stock}. This line says {count}. Is this more of it, kept somewhere else?
skippedIntro: Skipped by mistake? Bring it back, and it's checked again with the rest.

checkBroughtBack.one: Check the line you brought back
checkBroughtBack.other: Check the {count} lines you brought back

saveAndNext: Save and go to the next
photoSent: Sent: {name}. We check it in a minute.
photosAfter: We check each photo in a minute or two. If one isn't right, it comes back here with what to fix.
photoFrontHow: Take a photo of the front of the pack, where its name is.
photoSizeHow: Take a photo of the front of the pack. Make sure “{size}” can be read.
photoSideHow: Now a photo of the side where “{size}” is printed.
photoLooseHow: Take a photo of the {name} in its sack or bin.
findingPicture: We're looking for the company's own picture of it. You can take a photo anyway, or skip it for now.
takeSidePhoto: Take a photo of the side
guide_list_good: The whole page, flat and straight, in good light
guide_list_tip: One page per photo. Hold the phone straight above the page.
guide_pack_good: The front of one pack, its name and size clear
guide_pack_tip: Hold the phone steady, in good light. Only the product, no people.
guide_loose_good: The goods themselves, in their sack or bin
guide_loose_bad: A whole shelf of other things
guide_loose_tip: Close up, so the grains or pieces can be seen.
guide_face_good: Your face filling the photo, eyes open
guide_face_tip: Face the light. No cap or sunglasses.
guide_shopFront_good: From outside, the whole board readable
guide_shopFront_bad: Board cut off, or too dark
guide_shopFront_tip: Stand across the road in daylight so the whole front fits.
guide_video_good: Slowly, from the board to the shelves inside
guide_video_tip: Hold the phone steady and walk slowly. About 30 seconds is enough.
guide_fssai_good: The FSSAI certificate, the 14-digit number readable
guide_fssai_tip: The whole certificate, flat, in good light. A PDF of it is fine too.
guide_shopLicence_good: The whole licence, flat, name and address readable
guide_shopLicence_tip: Put it on a table and hold the phone straight above it.
fssaiNotReceipt: Upload the certificate itself, not the payment or application receipt.
fail_NOT_A_LIST: This doesn't look like a list of products. Take a photo of one page of your list.
fail_LIST_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read the products on this page. Take a clear, straight photo of the whole page in good light.
fail_CANT_OPEN: We couldn't open the photo. Take it again.
fail_TOO_LARGE: This photo is too large. Take it again.
fail_FILE_PASSWORD: This PDF has a password. Send it without one, or a photo of the page.
fail_FILE_CANT_OPEN: We couldn't open this file. Send the page as a photo or a PDF.
fail_TOO_LONG: This is too long to read at once. Send one page at a time.
fail_TRY_LATER: We couldn't read it just now. Take it again a little later, or add the products one by one.
fail_READING_OFF: Reading photos isn't switched on yet. Add your products one by one.
fail_PHOTO_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read this photo. Take a clear, straight photo in good light.
fail_OTHER: This page couldn't be read. Take it again.
photo_NOT_GOODS: This photo doesn't show the product. Take a photo of {name}.
photo_PEOPLE: Take the photo without people in it: only the product.
photo_MANY: Only one product in the photo, please: {name}.
photo_BLURRY: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady, in good light, and take it again.
photo_OTHER_PRODUCT: This doesn't look like {name}. Take a photo of {name}, or fix the product's name if it's wrong.
photo_NOT_FRONT: Take the photo of the front of the pack, where its name is.
photo_NEED_SIZE: We can't see the size on the front. Take a photo of the side where {size} is printed.
photo_SIZE_UNREADABLE: We still can't read the size. Take a clear photo of the side where {size} is printed.
photo_WRONG_SIZE: This pack says {seen}, but the product is {name}. Take a photo of the right pack, or fix the size in the product's name.
photo_PRODUCT_UNCLEAR: We couldn't see the product clearly. Take it again in good light, holding the phone steady.
photo_LABEL_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read the pack's label. Take a photo of the front of the pack.
photo_OTHER: This photo wasn't accepted. Take it again.
helperHintBody: You can bill, scan stock and take khata payments. Ask the owner to change prices, khata limits or old bills.
askOwnerDiscount: Please give a discount of ₹{amount} on this bill.
askOwnerUpiMessage: Please add our shop's UPI ID in the Clozest Partner app (More → UPI ID), so customers can pay by UPI.
askOwnerLimit: Please raise {name}'s khata limit in the Clozest Partner app.
askOwnerBill: Please change bill {billNo} in the Clozest Partner app.
askOwnerProduct: Please change {name} in the Clozest Partner app (price, name or alert).
billNowAddLater: Bill it now, add the product later
quickAddIntro: Barcode {code}: its name and price are enough now. It goes on the bill and scans from now on.
quickAddSave: Save and add to the bill

laterTitle.one: {count} barcode to add as a product

laterBody: Billed at the counter without a product. Add each one so it scans next time.
oneByOneIntro: One product at a time: its name, price and how many are on the shelf now.
leaveTyped: Leave? What you typed is kept until you close the app.
scanHow: Hold the barcode inside the box, 10–15 cm away, in good light.
stillNeeded: Still needed before you can submit:
removeProductBody: It won't scan or show at the counter any more. Old bills keep it, and you can put it back later.
removeBarcodeBody: Scanning it won't find {name} any more. To add it back, you'll have to scan the pack again.
stripStart: Set up your products: photograph your list
stripAskOwner: Setup ready: ask the owner to finish it
couldntRead: We couldn't check your product setup just now.
linesElsewhere: No lines left here right now: they may have been checked on another phone.
countElsewhere: No products left here right now: they may have been counted on another phone.
lineSavedAs: This line was already added with {count} ({name}). To change it, open the product and count it there.
countSavedAs: It shows {count} now (a sale or another phone's count came in). Check the shelf and save again.
samePhoto: You've sent this photo already (page {page}). Take a photo of the next page.
samePhotoHere: You've sent this photo already. Take a photo of the next page.
